title: Pitted Key
summary: Opens the Abandoned Refuge kitchen’s double iron doors.

fields.Lock: Double iron doors to the Abandoned Refuge kitchen.
fields.Acquisition: Skeleton at (−590, 409). Reach it via Misty Step or Gaseous Form, or jump in via stacked boxes with sufficient Strength.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
